name: diffbot/deepseek-v4.1-flash-exl3-3bpw-2x-rtx-pro-6000
title: Diffbot's 3-bit EXL3 pack runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at full 1M context on two RTX PRO 6000s with vLLM
summary: A 3 bpw EXL3 quant plus an optional CPU runtime keeps some routed experts in pinned host RAM so the full 1M context fits two 96 GB cards, with up to 289 tok/s reported on agentic coding.
